facts.quote: The data set labels each slide as one node by its largest focus
facts.basis: stages.csv carries one label per slide (five slides per patient) and the README says "whole-slide images of sentinel lymph node"; a slide may show more than one profile or fragment of nodal tissue. Stated as the data set's convention, not as anatomy; the owner confirms against Bandi et al. 2019 (Q20).
facts.note: S0.1 · One slide = one node · in cases/*.module.json (every case, the vignette)

facts.quote: pN categories follow CAMELYON17's simplified staging rules: AJCC pN0, pN0(i+), pN1mi, pN1 and pN2 by node count and largest deposit, with ITC-only nodes excluded from the positive-node count as in AJCC, and without the (sn) suffix, extranodal extension or pN3 that a full AJCC/CAP report carries.
facts.basis: FACTS §4.2 (SECONDARY wording from public code quoting the challenge; the rule set reproduces stages.csv for 100 of 100 patients, §4.1); the ITC exclusion is AJCC 8th edition's rule for breast pN, adopted by the challenge (PE-1). The owner confirms against the challenge's Evaluation page (Q3).
facts.note: S0.2 · Rules attribution · in client/src/signout/host/about.ts (About row "Staging rules", SIGNOUT.md §9.1)

facts.quote: A real report on five sentinel nodes would (1) add the (sn) suffix, e.g. pN1(sn), because only sentinel nodes were examined; (2) report extranodal extension (present/absent and its extent); (3) count nodes with macrometastasis, micrometastasis and isolated tumour cells separately; (4) measure the largest contiguous deposit, not an annotation outline; (5) say whether ITCs were found on H&E or by immunohistochemistry. CAMELYON17 labels carry none of these, so this practice report omits the (sn) suffix and extranodal extension and cannot score them.
facts.basis: AJCC 8th edition breast pN ((sn) suffix, ITC / micro / macro definitions, pN3); CAP breast sentinel-node protocol (extranodal extension, per-category counts, method of ITC detection). None of these is in CAMELYON17's labels (FACTS §0, §4).
facts.note: S0.3 · AJCC/CAP differences (§6.1a) · in client/src/signout/host/about.ts (About; also the report head and the comparison)
